name: Bilge Sash
flavour: It smells of the road, and the road smells of it.
note: Belt that lengthens flask duration, trades some charge gain for it, and speeds you while a flask is active, with physical damage, life, cold resistance and attack leech. Dropped: life leech applying to enemies as chaos damage.
drop: Movement Speed while using a Flask

name: Stockroom Girdle
flavour: Count the supplies twice, then count the exits.
note: Belt that fills flasks faster (50% increased charges gained) with physical damage, strength and intelligence. Dropped: the two attribute-threshold lines (elemental resistances at 200 strength, crit chance at 200 intelligence).

name: Moult Cord
flavour: Shed in one piece, and still warm.
note: Life, strength, intelligence, cold resistance and physical attack leech as life and mana. The life line is hand-written (capitalisation the translator misses).

name: Ashward Jerkin
flavour: The fire never gets past the stitching.
note: Evasion, life, fire resistance, cannot be ignited and flat physical damage reduction from attacks. Dropped: the socketed Added Fire Damage support and physical damage with ranged weapons.
drop: Supported by level 10 Added Fire Damage

name: Mindwall Robe
flavour: Hurt the thought before you hurt the thinker.
note: Evasion and energy shield, big mana pool, 1% of mana regenerated per second, and the keystone that takes damage from mana before life. Dropped: the extra 10% of damage taken from mana (the keystone already does it).
drop: of Damage is taken from Mana before Life

name: Rime Lattice
flavour: Frost is a kind of armour if you let it set.
note: Cold resistance, cannot be chilled, 20% of physical taken as cold, armour and energy shield, plus increased effect of chill. Dropped: 30% of fire damage taken as cold (only physical conversion exists).
drop: Fire Damage from Hits taken as Cold Damage

name: Drake Hide Plate
flavour: Scales turn a blade more often than a hand does.
note: Armour and evasion, leech and a 6% chance to dodge attacks, with endurance charges gained on kill and onslaught when hit. Dropped: losing all endurance charges when hit, and the per-charge onslaught duration and effect (flat onslaught chance used instead).

name: Russet Wraps
flavour: Light enough to run in, and always lucky about it.
note: Huge evasion while on full life, flat and percentage evasion, added physical damage to attacks, dexterity and movement speed. Dropped: enemies unlucky when damaging you on full life, and the level requirement line.

name: Hallowed Ringmail
flavour: Hold the faith and the faith holds you.
note: Armour and energy shield, life, all elemental resistances, and flat energy shield that grows with strength (0.9 per 5, the 0.45 scale applied).

name: Hoard Plate
flavour: Gold is heavy, and so is wanting it.
note: Item quantity and rarity paid for with fire and lightning resistance and movement speed. Dropped: reduced strength requirement.

name: Rimeshot Leathers
flavour: Every arrow arrives already frozen.
note: Dexterity, evasion, chill duration and dodge chances for attacks and spells. Dropped: added cold damage to bow attacks.

name: Ember Halo Mail
flavour: Something inside is burning and has chosen not to hurry.
note: Armour and energy shield, life, elemental damage gained as extra chaos and attack life leech. Dropped: 25% of elemental damage taken as chaos (no such conversion stat).
drop: Elemental Damage taken as Chaos Damage

name: Cinder Vestment
flavour: Cut from the part of the fire nobody sees.
note: Plus one to fire gems, fire damage, doubled crit chance, energy shield and fire converted to chaos. Dropped: increased spell damage taken on low mana.
drop: Spell Damage taken when on Low Mana

name: Voltaic Rags
flavour: The charge goes out of the dead and into the crowd.
note: Shocked enemies you kill explode for 5% of their maximum life as lightning damage (a kill trigger), unaffected by shock, life and effect of shock. Dropped: increased damage after shocking an enemy recently.

name: Emberhold Plate
flavour: No room for anything but a pulse.
note: No sockets, 500 life and fire damage on a heavy plate.

name: Seamed Leather
flavour: The cracks are the strongest part.
note: Evasion, life, fire resistance, 20% less damage taken while not hit recently and 50% increased evasion once hit recently.
drop: 20% less Damage taken if you have not been Hit Recently
50% increased Evasion if you have been Hit Recently

name: Blightward Mail
flavour: What strikes it comes away rotten.
note: Armour and energy shield, 30% physical converted to chaos and chaos damage reflected to melee attackers. Dropped: desecrated ground on block (ground effect).

name: Arc Cage
flavour: Every step crackles, and not kindly.
note: Added lightning damage to attacks, armour and evasion, life, a lightning resistance penalty and 30% of physical taken as lightning.

name: Prismwoven Mail
flavour: Every thread was picked for a different reason.
note: Six sockets, added physical, all attributes, crit chance, energy shield, life, mana, item rarity, elemental damage and a higher maximum for every resistance (+1 to +5, elemental and chaos).

name: Crackling Vestment
flavour: The static keeps the rot out.
note: Energy shield, faster start of recharge, lightning resistance, lightning reflect and chaos damage that does not bypass energy shield.
drop: faster start of Energy Shield Recharge
Chaos Damage does not bypass Energy Shield

name: Pale Vestment
flavour: Wear it once and it is yours for good.
note: Plus one to level of socketed gems and doubled global defences. Dropped: sockets cannot be modified, corrupted gems only.
drop: You can only Socket Corrupted Gems

name: Plain Shift
flavour: Plain cloth, remarkably well kept.
note: Plus one to level of socketed gems and doubled global defences. Dropped: sockets cannot be modified.

name: Brightsteel Cuirass
flavour: A shield for the part of you that is not steel.
note: Strength, armour and chaos damage that does not bypass energy shield. Dropped: flat and over-time chaos damage reduction.
drop: Chaos Damage does not bypass Energy Shield

name: Bare Cloth
flavour: Nothing on it, and nothing in the way.
note: Six sockets and nothing else. Links are not modelled, so only the socket count carries over.

name: Furlined Regalia
flavour: Warm, heavy and a little too proud.
note: Spell damage, energy shield, area of effect and increased energy shield recharge rate (standing in for recovery rate), at 5% increased damage taken.

name: Pact Silk Robe
flavour: Sign in red; it keeps the books.
note: Socketed gems cost and reserve life instead of mana, with intelligence, life and energy shield. Dropped: the socketed Added Chaos Damage support.
drop: Supported by level 15 Added Chaos Damage

name: Rampart Plate
flavour: It does not fall; the ground gives way first.
note: Attack block per 50 strength, strength, armour and a movement penalty. Dropped: unlucky spell block and the strength damage bonus rewrite.
drop: Chance to Block Spell Damage is Unlucky

name: Hutch Jerkin
flavour: Crowded inside, quick to leave.
note: Evasion, huge life, movement speed, with a fire resistance penalty and increased fire damage taken. Dropped: 10% of fire damage taken as physical.
drop: Fire Damage taken as Physical Damage

name: Drifting Veil
flavour: It will not let you stop, and you will not want to.
note: Life, evasion and energy shield, life regeneration per endurance charge and movement speed per frenzy charge. Dropped: increased charge duration.
drop: Endurance, Frenzy and Power Charge Duration

name: Festival Silks
flavour: A little of every colour, hung to dry.
note: Added fire, cold and lightning damage to spells and attacks with small flat life, mana, energy shield, evasion and resistances. Dropped: the socketed Elemental Proliferation support.

name: Coilscale Armour
flavour: Slow to wear, quick to bite.
note: Armour and evasion, life, cold resistance, movement speed, 20% chance to poison on hit with attacks and cannot be poisoned.
drop: chance to Poison on Hit with Attacks

name: Tinderstep Boots
flavour: Where it walks the grass gives up first.
note: Strength, movement speed, ignite chance, fire damage per 20 strength, and igniting enemies nearby when an ignited one dies (a kill trigger). Dropped: the triggered fury skill and burning hoofprints.
drop: Ignite a nearby Enemy on Killing

name: Shellstride Greaves
flavour: Sideways is still forward if you are armoured enough.
note: Armour, life, cold resistance and movement speed on boots. Dropped: the crab barrier lines.

name: Tithe Slippers
flavour: Every step is paid for.
note: Mana, lightning resistance, movement speed, quickened (20% attack, cast and movement speed) while not on low mana, and a steady mana drain.
drop: Onslaught while not on Low Mana

name: Streak Boots
flavour: Faster each time you forget to stop.
note: Armour and evasion, lightning resistance, movement speed and dodge per frenzy charge, and one more frenzy charge. Dropped: reduced frenzy charge duration.

name: Deathbed Greaves
flavour: Nothing frightens these boots; they have been there already.
note: Strength, armour and energy shield, all elemental resistances, movement speed, one more endurance charge, immunity to bleeding and longer elemental ailments on you.

name: Vesper Cassock
flavour: Sung over, never sung to.
note: Added lightning damage to attacks, energy shield and strong chaos resistance. Dropped: consecrated ground on block (ground effect).
